user.title: ACME certificate
user.description: Describe the certificate you want to issue.

data_description.domains: Comma separated, the first one becomes the certificate name. Wildcards are allowed, for example example.com,*.example.com
data_description.acme_server_url: Only used when the ACME server is set to Custom
data_description.email: The CA uses it for expiry notices, optional but recommended
data_description.days: Automatic renewal starts once the certificate has this many days left

data_description.eab_kid: Required by ZeroSSL, Google Trust Services and SSL.com
data_description.eab_hmac_key: Required by ZeroSSL, Google Trust Services and SSL.com

error.invalid_domains: At least one domain name is invalid
error.server_url_required: A directory URL is required when Custom is selected
error.credentials_required: Fill in at least one credential field
error.cannot_authenticate: The DNS provider rejected these credentials

abort.already_configured: This domain is already configured with the same CA

data.propagation_timeout: Seconds to wait for DNS propagation
data.reload_service: Service to call after installing the certificate

data_description.reload_service: For example homeassistant.restart, leave empty to do nothing

issue_certificate.name: Issue or renew a certificate
issue_certificate.description: Runs the ACME dns-01 flow right away and publishes the certificate.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: The certificate entry to issue for.

force.name: Force
force.description: Generate a new private key and request the certificate even when it is not due.
